$comment: REQ-CHR-001/002/003, DL-006. Counters are permanent and unbounded; notable entries are a bounded significance-ranked ring. Nothing here converts history into mechanical effect — that is BehaviorMemory's job alone.

notableRing.$comment: Entries below minSignificance never enter the ring. When full, the lowest-significance entry is displaced.

significance.$comment: 1 = routine, 5 = historic. Drives both ring retention and whether the entry is worth surfacing to the player (REQ-UX-005).
